label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The feature request is to add support for exporting reports in TSV format to the Ledgerline export functionality. Currently, only CSV and XLSX are supported as export formats in the ExportButton component and the underlying exportReport function. Adding TSV support would require updates to the export endpoint as well as the user interface to include TSV as an available export format option, addressing the user need for tab-delimited file exports compatible with their warehouse loader.
